budget.policy: November 3 administrative reset: LAB_WORKFLOW.md governs conditional whole-investigation allocation through existing BRIEF/STATE/registry. Current acquisition program is on investment HOLD with zero newly funded tranches/bookings. Future finite assignments derive from justified development, eligible confirmation, proportional independent challenge and expected iteration within actual resources above the 10% reserve. Legacy numeric daily/cycle/alternative/review/revision/continuation ceilings are historical baselines, not universal future quotas or authority to spend. Preserve saved_baseline_limits, date_scoped_overrides, continuation/sprint authority history, counters, actual prior charges and study-specific limits.

budget.current_program_allocation.reopening_condition: New exact assignment/acquisition/common-probe objects, credible deployed chronology, legitimate access/evaluation eligibility and an informative comparison, plus human scientific resumption and actual allowance. No generic source-search rerun.

pi.context_policy.pi_refresh: Actual context need, such as persistent confusion or unwieldy context; a genuinely new scientific question may warrant refresh. No third-pair quota. Carry the same unfinished objective, program, cumulative resources, remaining tests and exposure through an authorized sole-owner handoff.
governance.authority: Human-authorized November 3 administrative reset implements sustained-program investment, whole-investigation budgeting, proportional review, lean administration and reasoned scientific stopping above the 10% reserve. Science, its unfinished native goal and existing heartbeat remain paused; no scientific resumption, funded tranche or protected release.
governance.usage_check: Manually obtain get_usage_limits before scientific starts/continuations and major checkpoints; record actual observation time/source/all applicable remaining windows. Refresh a dispatch snapshot older than five minutes. At or below 10% stop science; unavailable telemetry defers it. Bookings are not usage. No controller or hook activation requirement.
